items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: He played banjo in there that he hired me to stay there on the guitar.

ctx.x: So you sometimes play a job like that and there would be very few people come to the dance? And you lose money on it?
Lose money, yeah. Yeah. Look, I want to tell you this, I played with, Dad hired me on the job, you remember him? Who?
